notice: FICTIONAL FIXTURE CORPUS. Every program, round, organisation, source and URL here is invented for slice 1A-0 tests. Nothing is a real program, a verified fact or advice. URLs use the reserved .invalid domain.

sources.title: Program A overview (fictional)
sources.text: Program A (fictional) supports Queensland founders who have a working prototype. Applicants need evidence of customer interest, such as interviews or letters of intent, before they apply to a round. Program A is delivered in rounds; each round publishes its own dates and conditions.

sources.title: Program A, Round A1: status (fictional)
sources.text: Round A1 of Program A (fictional) accepted applications from 1 July 2026 until 30 September 2026. The round is now closed and no late applications are accepted.

sources.title: Program A, Round A2: guidelines (fictional)
sources.text: Round A2 of Program A (fictional) is scheduled to open on 1 December 2026. Applicants must be a Queensland-registered company with a working prototype. From 1 December 2026, applicants must also complete an independent security assessment of their product.

sources.title: Program B, Round B1: status (fictional)
sources.text: Round B1 of Program B (fictional) is open for applications from founders anywhere in Australia.

sources.title: Book a founder session (fictional)
sources.text: The regional innovation hub network (fictional) offers free one-to-one founder sessions in person and remotely for founders across regional Queensland, including help choosing which programs to approach first.

sources.title: Before you chase a named program (fictional sample article)
sources.text: A useful order of work: first confirm who owns the intellectual property in your prototype, then gather evidence that customers want it, and only then apply to a named program round.

claims.text: Program A requires a working prototype and evidence of customer interest before you apply to a round.
Round A1 of Program A accepts applications until 30 September 2026.
Round A2 of Program A is scheduled to open on 1 December 2026.
Round A2 applicants must be a Queensland-registered company with a working prototype.
Round A2 applicants must complete an independent security assessment of their product.
Round B1 of Program B is open for applications from founders anywhere in Australia.
The regional innovation hub network offers free one-to-one founder sessions, in person and remotely, across regional Queensland.
Confirm who owns the intellectual property in your prototype before you chase a named program.
Gather evidence that customers want your product before applying to a program round.
